sections.title: Organization Provisioning — Flow
sections.description: Every client is an organization (tenant), created and configured from the parent platform

rows: Central control plane — owns, creates and governs every organization running on MALKOM 3.0. Org management • Platform governance
A new client organization is spun up from the parent platform — an isolated tenant with its own users, data and configuration. Per-org RBAC & data isolation
Per-organization platform setup: Queues — Q & Sub-Q • Deployment structure • Features. The deployment structure is selected here.

sections.title: Deployment Structure — Options
sections.description: Chosen per organization during configuration — same containerized codebase in every model (open architecture)

rows: Fastest onboarding — we run everything; the client consumes via browser & APIs.
Data-heavy features stay inside the client environment (data residency / gravity).
Full sovereignty — platform deployed into the client cloud or on-prem (K8s · MinIO).
Per-feature placement — each feature hosted where it fits best, set at org configuration.
payload.caption: One deployment structure is selected per organization

sections.title: Common to Every Model
sections.description: The deployment choice never changes the product — one open, containerized platform

rows: Containerized, open architecture — identical in every deployment model
Q & Sub-Q configuration scoped per organization
AAG connectors bridge clouds — storage · DB · SFTP · email
